name: Stageshow (agent skill for faux product UI)
summary: Agent skill that teaches coding agents to build believable faux product UI in React and plain CSS: stills, feature cards, bento grids and cursor-driven demo animations. Ships a component kit, gold examples, framing/motion references and tools that film the result so the agent can check its own work.

access.notes: MIT covers Stageshow source; bundled app icons are not covered and stay with their owners; product names/marks in examples grant no trademark rights (see NOTICE.md).

procedure: Run: npx skills add benjitaylor/skills --skill stageshow
Or copy the stageshow/ folder from github.com/benjitaylor/skills into your agent's skills directory.
Ask your agent for a faux UI still, hero demo or bento grid; read benji.org/stageshow for how it works.

verdict.why: Real MIT-licensed skill with kit, examples and self-check tooling; high signal launch post (446k views, 11.7k bookmarks). Niche: UI illustration for marketing/docs, not a 3D/media asset.

image.alt: Grid of faux product UI made with Stageshow: controls panel, revenue dashboard, Japanese keyboard, app icons and a music player
